steps.name: project-setup
steps.summary: Next.js 15.5 + React 19 + Tailwind v4 + TS 스캐폴드(src/), vitest.config.ts, test/prisma.seed 스크립트, globals.css @theme navy 토큰 5종 + Pretendard, layout.tsx(ko, CDN 폰트), .env.example, vercel.json cron, 의존성(@prisma/client@6 bcryptjs jose lucide-react @dnd-kit/core @dnd-kit/utilities @vercel/blob / prisma@6 vitest tsx @types/bcryptjs @types/node@22) 설치. lint/build/test 통과.

steps.name: db-schema
steps.summary: prisma/schema.prisma(enum 5종 + User/Project/ProjectMember/Feature/WeeklyUpdate/PlanDoc/Question, Cascade/SetNull 관계), src/lib/db.ts PrismaClient 싱글턴, prisma/seed.ts 멱등 시드(운영진 upsert + code 기준 Project upsert, Feature는 0개일 때만 생성). DATABASE_URL 없어 migrate diff로 prisma/migrations/0001_init/migration.sql + migration_lock.toml 생성, 시드 미실행(실 DB 적용은 prisma migrate deploy + db seed 필요).
